title: Add EditDoseDialog
description: Lets the user correct a previously-logged dose's amount and time. Mirrors EditMedicationDialog/EditProfileDialog's AlertDialog + Save/Cancel structure, but with no Delete button (only editing was requested; doses have no archive/delete concept). Shows the medication name as read-only context since DoseRow doesn't otherwise display it inline with editing.
acceptance_criteria: @Composable fun EditDoseDialog(doseLog: DoseLog, medicationName: String, onDismiss: () -> Unit, onSave: (doseAmount: String, givenAtEpochMillis: Long) -> Unit)
Local state for doseAmount and givenAtEpochMillis seeded from doseLog's existing values
Shows medicationName as a read-only Text for context, an OutlinedTextField for dose amount (label: dose_given_label), and a TimeTakenField seeded from givenAtEpochMillis
Confirm button (label: save) only calls onSave(doseAmount, givenAtEpochMillis) if doseAmount is not blank
